method: Each candidate endpoint was fetched directly and its payload parsed as RSS, Atom, or JSON Feed. Captures are recorded with the number of items actually read; large hot lists were captured partially, which is noted per candidate. Tidings parser rounds were not available in the authoring environment, so this round records HTTP fetch plus feed-parse evidence only.
timezone_note: Review timestamps are Asia/Macau (UTC+8); feed timestamps are reproduced in UTC as published.
